training_weather.source: Matched ResStock embedded temperature; EST end converted to UTC start

prediction_weather.source: NOAA Global Hourly; explicitly flagged short-gap interpolation
prediction_weather.gap_policy: Linear elapsed-time interpolation for bounded interior gaps only; no edge filling
prediction_weather.aggregation: Mean of accepted reports per UTC hour; not a time-weighted temperature integral

limitations: Temperature-only response; no humidity, thermal lag or equipment saturation.
Fixed population and equipment; no automatic adoption/growth trend.
Deterministic hourly schedules; not individual appliance event simulation.
diagnostics.spatial_weather_basis: One airport proxy for county; no spatial microclimate weighting
